reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing pattern (a shared NO_TEMPLATE_SQL exclusion used by each action) by adding one getFixedCategoryIds helper that every month-wide action uses.

duplication.why: The tag rule is defined once, but the same fetch-plus-skip block is pasted into all six month-wide actions instead of joining the shared exclusion in their queries or a common selection step.

placement.why: The helper sits next to NO_TEMPLATE_SQL in budget/actions.ts with the actions it serves.

maintainability.why: A new month-wide action must remember a third separate exclusion step (SQL template filter, income check, fixed set), and each action runs an extra query, so the scattered selection logic grows.

one_place.where: getFixedCategoryIds/FIXED_TAG in budget/actions.ts defines the rule once; each of the six month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) calls it and applies its own skip
